# Contributing To che

Tool `che`, one of the artifacts of [che/homebrew-tap](https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/homebrew-tap).

Contributions are very welcome, and collaboration initiatives especially so. Before writing code, open an issue or get in touch: a short conversation first saves the effort of a contribution that was never going to fit. Small or uncertain contributions are welcome too, and questions about the direction of the project are as useful as patches.

This repository is mirrored to GitHub, but GitLab is where the work happens. Issues and merge requests on GitLab are seen; pull requests opened on the GitHub mirror are not. Please contribute on GitLab.

## What Contributions Are Welcome

- Comments on open merge requests.
- Issues on GitLab: feature suggestions, bug reports, security issues.
- Constructive critique of the purpose and goals of the project, sincerely welcome, by private message.

## Getting In Touch

- Issues: <https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/homebrew-tap/-/issues>
- Merge requests: <https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/homebrew-tap/-/merge_requests>
- Email: <odwrotkonrad@gmail.com>, <zagozdakonrad@gmail.com>
- LinkedIn: <https://www.linkedin.com/in/odwrotkonrad/>

## If I Do Not Respond

I make an effort to monitor issues on GitLab, but a missed issue is not a rejection. If you do not hear back, please do not hesitate to reach me through any of the contacts above: I guarantee a response within 3 days.

Contributions are valued a lot, and so is the time spent on them. Do not hesitate if a contribution feels small, or if you are unsure it is right. I am glad to discuss it and to converge on a shared view.

## How To Contribute

Formulae here are generated by che's release job, so a formula edit in this repository is overwritten by the next release. Change how a formula is produced in [che](https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/che), not here.

A packaging problem that is genuinely the tap's own, such as the tap's structure or its documentation, belongs in a merge request against `main`.
